highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 advances to the Skia m153 renderer with its upstream correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Linux applications relying on implicit font fallback should review the changed fontconfig selection behavior before upgrading.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback can select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, so applications that rely on the exact fallback face can see different glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or use a bundled typeface, when deterministic selection matters.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates its upstream correctness and buffer-upload fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: The release candidate validated the m153 update for the 4.153 release line.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates native HarfBuzz package validation for the 4.153 release line.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: Linux applications that rely on implicit font fallback should verify their selected typefaces after upgrading.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate validates the Skia m153 engine update.
